outreach:
Hello,

I read the public reporting that an external CEO was appointed.

At Mergero, we work with owners considering succession. That may or may not be relevant to your plans. Any conversation would start with your priorities for Integration Test Works.

Would a brief, confidential conversation be useful? There is no assumption that you are looking to sell or seeking investment.

Best regards,
Mergero
